description: configure/needs.yaml: this pack's section of the World's Interaction List. Every key is optional; an empty file keeps the pack's own defaults.

consequences.description: What this pack's facts mean for who perceives them and for history.

items.description: A consequence entry: for one fact and a selector per role it names, its audience, whether it is biographical, and the pack's knobs.

actor.description: * for anyone, or an entity class: one defined in configure/classes.yaml, or an implicit class (person, place, item, organization).

audience.description: Who may perceive the fact: only narrower than its owner's audience, and no narrower than the narrowest the owner allows.

biography.description: Whether the fact enters the biographies of the people in it: on or off, where the owner lets a list choose.

fact.description: The fact the entry is about: one this pack lets a list govern.

default.description: What an action no rule matches gets: permit (when unsaid) or forbid.

extends.description: A reference list of this pack to start from; the section's entries are added after it. Chains of at most four lists, with no cycle.

parameters.description: This pack's numbers, for everyone or for the classes the entry names.

items.description: A parameter entry: a selector per role it names, and the parameters it sets. With no role named it is the section's base.

actor.description: * for anyone, or an entity class: one defined in configure/classes.yaml, or an implicit class (person, place, item, organization).

hunger_asleep_per_hour.description: How much hunger rises per hour asleep: suppressed in sleep, so breakfast follows a night rather than a famine (authored).

hunger_per_hour.description: How much hunger rises per hour awake: from sated to hungry (600) in 5 hours by default, the spacing of the American Time Use Survey's meal peaks.

rest_per_hour.description: How much tiredness falls per hour asleep at level 300: the fall is in proportion to the level (the two-process model's recovery, Q-Nc3-5; `mineworld_sleep::recovery`), so an 8-hour night from 1 000 ends near 35, about 121 per hour on average.

restore.description: What restores each need: hunger from [eating], tiredness from [sleeping].

thresholds.description: The thresholds between a need's words: three integers in 1 … 1 000, strictly increasing.

tiredness_per_hour.description: How much tiredness rises per hour awake: 1 000 over the ~16.7 waking hours of a day with an 8-hour night.
